change: Optional matching host bounds allow XMX to form prefix sums of valid token tiles for up to 16 experts. Dot products and reduction order are unchanged. The option defaults off.

specialized_revision.method: Same final AOT binary; off1/on1/on2/off2/off3/on3 per prompt. The initial off1/on1 screen used 4k then short, followed by remaining short pairs then remaining 4k pairs. Normal runs without phase profiling or concurrent owned builds/GPU tests. Exact tile8, packing off, ring8, same-queue event omission.

accepted_binary_controls.interpretation: One additional normal run per size after the final paired measurements, using the previously accepted AOT. These are control samples, not another three-pair comparison.

scope: Same final-binary off/on gains are 4.70% for 4,007 prefetched tokens and 1.21% for 826. Accepted-binary controls are separate single runs. No decode-speed improvement is claimed.

reproduction.normal_pairs: Load oneAPI and run repeat.py --exe PATH_TO_FINAL_AOT from this directory. It uses the preceding prefill-events helper and workstation model/config/fixtures.
reproduction.components: ctest --test-dir BUILD --output-on-failure -R ^sycl_prefill_mmq ; additional AOT exact compact tests used tile 1/2/4 and a linear tile-8 test.
reproduction.serving: tools/sycl/serve_bench.py with the flags and environments saved in specialized_revision.validation; compare completed outputs to the preceding prefill-event and routed-full-serve records. Raw helpers and fixtures are in the local archive.

initial_prototype.method: Normal execution, no profiling and no concurrent owned builds or GPU tests. Accepted binary compared with the compact candidate; exact tile 8, packing off, ring 8, same-queue event omission. First candidate run: 4k then short. For each size, remaining order old1/old2/new2/new3/old3, processing short then 4k. All samples retained. Existing workstation workloads left active.

initial_component_validation.scope: Existing prefill suite with exact tile 8 and compaction; added bitwise comparisons to the uniform-grid path for six types, 1/16/17 experts and three ragged/empty patterns. Existing oracle and canary checks retained.
